executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by open-source stack, frontier research, governance and controls. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.
strategicTakeaways: The open-source layer is turning into a strategic option set for AI stack design, not only a hobbyist ecosystem.
Research matters most when it changes the product and deployment baseline, not only leaderboard positioning.
Governance is moving from compliance overlay to product requirement for deployable AI.
businessImpactSummary: This signal matters because it changes how teams in operations can structure AI-assisted execution, evaluation, or governance. This signal matters because it changes how teams in strategy can structure AI-assisted execution, evaluation, or governance.
predictionUpdates: Research progress will matter most when it changes deployment economics and evaluation standards
